algorithms.name: XML serialization
algorithms.html: To produce an XML serialization of a Node node given a boolean require well-formed, run the following steps:

steps.html: Let namespace be null.
Let prefix map be «» (a namespace prefix map).
Add "xml" to prefix map given the XML namespace.
Let prefix index be 1.

Return the result of running the XML serialization algorithm given node, namespace, prefix map, a mutable reference to prefix index, and require well-formed. If an exception occurs during the execution of the algorithm, then catch that exception and throw an "InvalidStateError" DOMException.

algorithms.name: XML serialization algorithm
algorithms.html: The XML serialization algorithm, given a Node node, a string namespace, a namespace prefix map prefix map, a mutable reference to an integer prefix index, and a boolean require well-formed, must run the following steps:

steps.html: If <var data-type="Node">node</var>'s interface is:
Run the algorithm for XML serializing an Element node given node, namespace, namespace prefix map, prefix index and require well-formed.
Run the algorithm for XML serializing a Document node given node, namespace, namespace prefix map, prefix index and require well-formed.
Run the algorithm for XML serializing a Comment node given node and require well-formed.
Run the algorithm for XML serializing a CDATASection node given node and require well-formed.
Run the algorithm for XML serializing a Text node given node and require well-formed.
Run the algorithm for XML serializing a DocumentFragment node given node, namespace, namespace prefix map, prefix index and require well-formed.
Run the algorithm for XML serializing a DocumentType node given node and require well-formed.
Run the algorithm for XML serializing a ProcessingInstruction node given node and require well-formed.
Return the empty string.
Throw a TypeError. Only Nodes and Attrs can be serialized by this algorithm.

algorithms.name: XML serializing an Element node
algorithms.html: The algorithm for XML serializing an Element node, given an Element node, a string namespace, a namespace prefix map prefix map, a mutable reference to an integer prefix index, and a boolean require well-formed, must run the following steps:

steps.html: If require well-formed is true, and node's local name contains the character ":" (U+003A COLON) or does not match the XML Name production, then throw an exception.
Let markup be "<" (U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN).
Let <var data-type="string">qualified name</var> be the empty string.
Let <var data-type="boolean">skip end tag</var> be false.
Let <var data-type="boolean">ignore namespace definition attribute</var> be false.
Let map be the result of copy a namespace prefix map given prefix map.
Let local prefixes map be « » (an ordered map from strings to strings).
Let local default namespace be the result of recording the namespace information for node's attribute list given map and local prefixes map.
Let <var>inherited ns</var> be <var data-type="string">namespace</var>.
Let ns be node's namespace.
If <var>inherited ns</var> is <var>ns</var>, then:

If <var>local default namespace</var> is not null, then set
      <var data-type="boolean">ignore namespace definition attribute</var> to true.
If ns is the XML namespace, then append the concatenation of "xml:" and node's local name to qualified name.
Otherwise, append node's local name to qualified name.
Append <var data-type="string">qualified name</var> to <var data-type="string">markup</var>.
Otherwise:
Let prefix be node's namespace prefix.
Let candidate prefix be the result of retrieving a preferred prefix string prefix from map given ns.
If prefix is "xmlns", then:
If require well-formed is true, then throw an exception.
Set <var>candidate prefix</var> to <var>prefix</var>.

<dfn id="dfn-found-a-suitable-namespace-prefix" tabindex="0" aria-haspopup="dialog" data-dfn-type="dfn">Found a suitable namespace prefix</dfn>: if <var>candidate prefix</var> is not
      null, then:
Append the concatenation of candidate prefix, ":" (U+003A COLON), and node's local name to qualified name.
If local default namespace is not null (node has a default namespace declaration attribute) and is not the XML namespace, then:

If <var>local default namespace</var> is the empty string, set
          <var>inherited ns</var> to null.
Otherwise, set <var>inherited ns</var> to <var>local default namespace</var>.
Append <var data-type="string">qualified name</var> to <var data-type="string">markup</var>.
Otherwise, if <var>prefix</var> is not null, then:
If local prefixes map contains prefix, then set prefix to the result of generating a prefix given map, ns, and prefix index.
Add prefix to map given ns.
Append the concatenation of prefix, ":" (U+003A COLON), and node's local name to qualified name.
Append <var data-type="string">qualified name</var> to <var data-type="string">markup</var>.
Append the following to <var data-type="string">markup</var>, in the order listed:
ignored: " " (U+0020 SPACE); "xmlns:"; prefix; "="" (U+003D EQUALS SIGN, U+0022 QUOTATION MARK); The result of serializing an attribute value given ns and require well-formed; """ (U+0022 QUOTATION MARK).

steps.html:
If <var>local default namespace</var> is not null (<var data-type="Element">node</var> has a
        default namespace declaration attribute), then:

If <var>local default namespace</var> is the empty string, set
          <var>inherited ns</var> to null.
Otherwise, set <var>inherited ns</var> to <var>local default namespace</var>.

Otherwise, if <var>local default namespace</var> is null, or
      <var>local default namespace</var> is not null and its value is not equal
      to <var>ns</var>, then:
Set <var data-type="boolean">ignore namespace definition attribute</var> to true.
Append node's local name to qualified name.
Set <var>inherited ns</var> to <var>ns</var>.
Append <var data-type="string">qualified name</var> to <var data-type="string">markup</var>.
Append the following to <var data-type="string">markup</var>, in the order listed:
ignored: " " (U+0020 SPACE); "xmlns"; "="" (U+003D EQUALS SIGN, U+0022 QUOTATION MARK); The result of serializing an attribute value given ns and require well-formed; """ (U+0022 QUOTATION MARK).

steps.html: Otherwise:
Append node's local name to qualified name.
Set <var>inherited ns</var> to <var>ns</var>.
Append <var data-type="string">qualified name</var> to <var data-type="string">markup</var>.
Append to markup the result of the XML serialization of the attributes of node given map, prefix index, local prefixes map, ignore namespace definition attribute, and require well-formed.

If ns is the HTML namespace, and node's children is empty, and node's local name is one of the following: "area", "base", "basefont", "bgsound", "br", "col", "embed", "frame", "hr", "img", "input", "keygen", "link", "menuitem", "meta", "param", "source", "track", "wbr"; then append the following to markup, in the order listed: and set skip end tag to true.
If ns is not the HTML namespace, and node's children is empty, then append "/" (U+002F SOLIDUS) to markup and set skip end tag to true.
Append ">" (U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN) to markup.
If <var data-type="boolean">skip end tag</var> is true, then return <var data-type="string">markup</var>.

If ns is the HTML namespace, and node's local name is "template" (this is a template element), append to markup the result of XML serializing a DocumentFragment node given node's template contents (a DocumentFragment), inherited ns, map, prefix index, and require well-formed.
Otherwise, for each child of node's children:
Append to markup the result of running the XML serialization algorithm given child, inherited ns, map, prefix index, and require well-formed.
Append the following to <var data-type="string">markup</var>, in the order listed:
ignored: "</" (U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN, U+002F SOLIDUS); qualified name; ">" (U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN).

steps.html: Return <var data-type="string">markup</var>.

algorithms.name: recording the namespace information
algorithms.html: When recording the namespace information for a list of attributes attributes, given a namespace prefix map map and an ordered map local prefixes map, run the following steps:

steps.html: Let <var>default namespace attr value</var> be null.
For each attr of attributes:
Let attribute namespace be attr's namespace.
Let attribute prefix be attr's namespace prefix.
If attribute namespace is the XMLNS namespace, then:
If attribute prefix is null (attr is a default namespace declaration), set default namespace attr value to attr's value, and continue.
Otherwise:
Let prefix definition be attr's local name.
Let namespace definition be attr's value.
If namespace definition is the XML namespace, then continue.

If <var>namespace definition</var> is the empty string (the declarative form of
          having no namespace), then set <var>namespace definition</var> to null.
If prefix definition is found in map given namespace definition, then continue.
Add prefix definition to map given namespace definition.

If <var>namespace definition</var> is null, then set <var>namespace definition</var> to
          the empty string.

Set <var>local prefixes map</var>[<var>prefix definition</var>] to
          <var>namespace definition</var>.
Return <var>default namespace attr value</var>.

algorithms.name: copy a namespace prefix map
algorithms.html: To <dfn id="dfn-copy-a-namespace-prefix-map" tabindex="0" aria-haspopup="dialog" data-dfn-type="dfn">copy a namespace prefix map</dfn> <var>map</var>:

steps.html: Let copy be a new namespace prefix map.
For each key → value in map:
Set copy[key] to a clone of value.
Return <var>copy</var>.

algorithms.name: retrieving a preferred prefix string
algorithms.html: To retrieve a preferred prefix string preferred prefix (a string or null) from the namespace prefix map map given a namespace ns:

steps.html: If map does not contain ns, return null.
Let <var>candidates</var> be <var>map</var>[<var>ns</var>].
Assert: candidates is not empty.
If <var>prefix</var> is not null, then:
For each prefix of candidates:
If <var>prefix</var> is <var>preferred prefix</var>, return <var>prefix</var>.
Return candidates[size of candidates - 1].

algorithms.name: found
algorithms.html: To check if a string prefix is found in a namespace prefix map map given a namespace ns:

steps.html: If map does not contain ns, return false.
Let <var>candidates</var> be <var>map</var>[<var>ns</var>].
If candidates contains prefix, return true, otherwise return false.

algorithms.name: add
algorithms.html: To add a string prefix to a namespace prefix map map given a namespace ns:

steps.html: If map does not contain ns:
Let <var>candidates</var> be « <var>prefix</var> ».
Set <var>map</var>[<var>ns</var>] to <var>candidates</var>.
Otherwise:
Let <var>candidates</var> be <var>map</var>[<var>ns</var>].
Append prefix to candidates.

algorithms.name: XML serialization of the attributes
algorithms.html: The XML serialization of the attributes of an Element element given a namespace prefix map map, a mutable reference to an integer prefix index, an ordered map local prefixes map, a boolean ignore namespace definition attribute, and a boolean require well-formed, is the result of the following algorithm:

steps.html: Let <var>result</var> be the empty string.
Let localname set be « » (an empty ordered set).
For each attr of element's attribute list:
Let attribute namespace be attr's namespace.
Let attrName be a new tuple (attribute namespace, attr's local name).
If require well-formed is true, and localname set contains attrName, then throw an exception.
Append attrName to localname set.
Let <var>candidate prefix</var> be null.
If <var>attribute namespace</var> is not null, then:
Let prefix be attr's namespace prefix.
Set candidate prefix to the result of retrieving a preferred prefix string prefix from map given attribute namespace.
If attribute namespace is the XMLNS namespace, then:

If any of the following are true, then continue:
  • attr's value is the XML namespace;
  • prefix is null and ignore namespace definition attribute is true (the Element's default namespace attribute is to be skipped);
  • prefix is not null and either
    • local prefixes map does not contain attr's local name, or
    • local prefixes map does contain attr's local name, but local prefixes map[attr's local name] is not attr's value
    and furthermore that attr's local name is found in map given attr's value (the current namespace prefix definition was exactly defined previously—on an ancestor element, not element).
If require well-formed is true, and attr's value is the XMLNS namespace, then throw an exception.
If require well-formed is true, and attr's value is the empty string, then throw an exception.
If prefix is "xmlns", then set candidate prefix to "xmlns".
Otherwise (attribute namespace is not the XMLNS namespace), if candidate prefix is null:
If prefix is not null and local prefixes map does not contain prefix, set candidate prefix to prefix.
Otherwise, set candidate prefix to the result of generating a prefix given map, attribute namespace, and prefix index.
Add candidate prefix to map given attribute namespace.

Let <var>map value</var> be the empty string if <var>attribute namespace</var> is null, and
          <var>attribute namespace</var> otherwise.
Set local prefixes map[candidate prefix] to map value.
Append the following to <var>result</var>, in the order listed:
ignored: " " (U+0020 SPACE); "xmlns:"; candidate prefix; "="" (U+003D EQUALS SIGN, U+0022 QUOTATION MARK); The result of serializing an attribute value given attribute namespace and require well-formed; """ (U+0022 QUOTATION MARK).

steps.html: Append " " (U+0020 SPACE) to result.
If candidate prefix is not null, then append to result the concatenation of candidate prefix and ":" (U+003A COLON).

If require well-formed is true, and attr's local name contains the character ":" (U+003A COLON) or does not match the XML Name production or equals "xmlns" and attribute namespace is null, then throw an exception.
Append the following to <var>result</var>, in the order listed:
ignored: attr's local name; "="" (U+003D EQUALS SIGN, U+0022 QUOTATION MARK); The result of serializing an attribute value given attr's value and require well-formed; """ (U+0022 QUOTATION MARK).

steps.html: Return <var>result</var>.

algorithms.name: serializing an attribute value
algorithms.html:
When <dfn id="dfn-serializing-an-attribute-value" tabindex="0" aria-haspopup="dialog" data-dfn-type="dfn">serializing an attribute value</dfn> given a string or null <var>attribute value</var> and a
  boolean <var>require well-formed</var>, run the following steps:

steps.html: If require well-formed is true, and attribute value contains characters that are not matched by the XML Char production, then throw an exception.
If <var>attribute value</var> is null, then return the empty string.

Otherwise, return <var>attribute value</var>, first replacing any occurrences of the
    following:
ignored:
"&" with "&" """ with """ "<" with "<" U+0009 CHARACTER TABULATION with "	" U+000A LINE FEED (LF) with "
" U+000D CARRIAGE RETURN (CR) with ""

algorithms.name: generating a prefix
algorithms.html: To generate a prefix given a namespace prefix map map, a string new namespace, and a mutable reference to an integer prefix index:

steps.html: Let generated prefix be the concatenation of "ns" and the current numerical value of prefix index.
Increment the value of <var>prefix index</var> by one.
Add generated prefix to map given new namespace.
Return the value of <var>generated prefix</var>.

algorithms.name: XML serializing a Document node
algorithms.html: The algorithm for XML serializing a Document node, given a Document node, a string namespace, a namespace prefix map prefix map, a mutable reference to an integer prefix index, and a boolean require well-formed, must run the following steps:

steps.html: If require well-formed is true, and node's document element is null, then throw an exception.
Otherwise:
Let <var>serialized document</var> be the empty string.
For each child of node's children:
Append to serialized document the result of running the XML serialization algorithm given child, inherited ns, map, prefix index, and require well-formed.
Return <var>serialized document</var>.

algorithms.name: XML serializing a Comment node
algorithms.html: The algorithm for XML serializing a Comment node, given a Comment node, and a boolean require well-formed, must run the following steps:

steps.html: If require well-formed is true, and node's data contains characters that are not matched by the XML Char production or contains "--" (two adjacent U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS characters) or ends with a "-" (U+002D HYPHEN-MINUS) character, then throw an exception.
Otherwise, return the concatenation of "<!--", node's data, and "-->".

algorithms.name: XML serializing a CDATASection node
algorithms.html: The algorithm for XML serializing a CDATASection node, given a CDATASection node, and a boolean require well-formed, must run the following steps:

steps.html: Let markup be the concatenation of "<![CDATA[", node's data, and "]]>".
Return <var>markup</var>.

algorithms.name: XML serializing a Text node
algorithms.html: The algorithm for XML serializing a Text node, given a Text node, and a boolean require well-formed, must run the following steps:

steps.html: Let markup be node's data.
If require well-formed is true, and markup contains characters that are not matched by the XML Char production, then throw an exception.
Replace any occurrences of "&" in markup by "&".
Replace any occurrences of "<" in markup by "<".
Replace any occurrences of ">" in markup by ">".
Return <var>markup</var>.

algorithms.name: XML serializing a DocumentFragment node
algorithms.html: The algorithm for XML serializing a DocumentFragment node, given a DocumentFragment node, a string namespace, a namespace prefix map prefix map, a mutable reference to an integer prefix index, and a boolean require well-formed, must run the following steps:

steps.html: Let <var>markup</var> be the empty string.
For each child of node's children:
Append to markup the result of running the XML serialization algorithm given child, inherited ns, map, prefix index, and require well-formed.
Return <var>markup</var>.

algorithms.name: XML serializing a DocumentType node
algorithms.html: The algorithm for XML serializing a DocumentType node, given a DocumentType node, and a boolean require well-formed, must run the following steps:

steps.html: If require well-formed is true, and node's public ID contains characters that are not matched by the XML PubidChar production, then throw an exception.

If require well-formed is true, and node's system ID contains characters that are not matched by the XML Char production or that contains both a """ (U+0022 QUOTATION MARK) and a "'" (U+0027 APOSTROPHE), then throw an exception.
Let <var>markup</var> be the empty string.
Append "<!DOCTYPE" to markup.
Append " " (U+0020 SPACE) to markup.
Append node's name to markup.
If node's public ID is not the empty string, then append the following, in the order listed, to markup:
ignored: " " (U+0020 SPACE); "PUBLIC"; " " (U+0020 SPACE); the serialization of the ID node's public ID.

steps.html: If node's system ID is not the empty string and node's public ID is the empty string, then append the following, in the order listed, to markup:
If node's system ID is not the empty string, then append the following, in the order listed, to markup:
ignored: " " (U+0020 SPACE); the serialization of the ID node's system ID.

steps.html: Append ">" (U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN) to markup.
Return <var>markup</var>.

algorithms.name: serialization of the ID
algorithms.html: The <dfn id="dfn-serialization-of-the-id" tabindex="0" aria-haspopup="dialog" data-dfn-type="dfn">serialization of the ID</dfn> <var data-type="string">id</var> is the result of the following steps:

steps.html: If id contains """ (U+0022 QUOTATION MARK), let q be "'" (U+0027 APOSTROPHE), and let q be """ (U+0022 QUOTATION MARK) otherwise.
Return the concatenation of <var>q</var>, <var data-type="string">id</var>, and <var>q</var>.

algorithms.name: XML serializing a ProcessingInstruction node
algorithms.html: The algorithm for XML serializing a ProcessingInstruction node, given a ProcessingInstruction node, and a boolean require well-formed, must run the following steps:

steps.html: If require well-formed is true, and node's target contains a ":" (U+003A COLON) character or is an ASCII case-insensitive match for "xml", then throw an exception.

If require well-formed is true, and node's data contains characters that are not matched by the XML Char production or contains "?>" (U+003F QUESTION MARK, U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN), then throw an exception.
Let <var>markup</var> be the concatenation of the following, in the order listed:
ignored: "<?" (U+003C LESS-THAN SIGN, U+003F QUESTION MARK); node's target; " " (U+0020 SPACE); node's data; "?>" (U+003F QUESTION MARK, U+003E GREATER-THAN SIGN).

steps.html: Return <var>markup</var>.
